read.thesis: Hilton Q2 CY26 system RevPAR +3.9% with 6.1% NUG and record 541,300-room pipeline, but supply growth is pipeline-led and capital returns are heavy; FY RevPAR guide trimmed to 3.0–3.5%.

triggers.label: Q2 RevPAR +3.9% (ADR and occupancy up)
triggers.quote: System-wide comparable RevPAR increased 3.9 percent compared to the same period in 2025 due to an increase in both occupancy and ADR.

triggers.label: Pipeline record 541,300 rooms, +6%
triggers.quote: bringing our development pipeline to 541,300 rooms as of June 30, 2026, representing growth of 6 percent from June 30, 2025

triggers.label: FY RevPAR guide 3.0–3.5%
triggers.quote: Full year 2026 system-wide RevPAR is projected to increase between 3.0 percent and 3.5 percent

guidance.quote: projected to increase between 3.0 percent and 3.5 percent
Net unit growth is projected to be between 6.0 percent and 7.0 percent
Adjusted EBITDA is projected to be between $4,040 million and $4,080 million.
Capital return is projected to be approximately $3.5 billion.
projected to increase approximately 4.0 percent compared to the third quarter of 2025
